messages.author: Ellis
messages.text:
The W has it's history and it's always fun to follow. Would love to play but dynasty format is quite the commitment for me personally...
Anyways, it's still fun to brainstorm on this league. As a fan of this league it would be fun to watch a 2 tier league format. 2 divisions. One higher and the other lower. Not horizontal. Each div plays it's own div 4 or more games and the other tier 2 times. Perhaps not everyone plays everyone from the other tier? Some kind of promotion relegation. What really hit me tonight on B&B cast was someone saying how the seeding doesn't really mean much with a few exceptions and I agreed.

messages.author: Ellis
messages.text: I know this has all been discussed before and this is nothing new but just saying as a viewer it sounds fun.
